collector.name: essentials
collector.text:
EssentialsX collector.

Runs in the background because of the balance top ranking: `calculateBalanceTopMapAsync()` reads every account. We don't trigger it — EssentialsX refreshes it on its own — we read its cache and publish its age, so a stale total shows up instead of passing for a stable economy.

The Gini coefficient says in one number whether the economy is concentrated in a handful of players. 0 = everyone has the same, 1 = one player has everything. It's the kind of thing a top-ten ranking never shows.
